description: POST /v1/merchants/me/balance/topups - starts a top-up of the Live prepaid balance: creates a pending top-up and a payment session for that amount, and returns its paymentUrl. Nothing is credited until that session is paid and settles; give the paymentUrl to whoever pays, then follow the top-up with paymaster_balance_topups_list. Minimum $1.00. Every call starts a new top-up, so do not repeat it after an uncertain result. Live only - Test needs no funding. Requires a fresh JWT.

amountUsd.description: USD amount as a decimal string, e.g. "50.00".

name: paymaster_balance_topup_create
title: Start a balance top-up
